_comment: Copy this to pcconfig.json (gitignored) and fill in your values. Run pcsync from the game/ folder. TARGET_SUBDIR 'src' means only game/src/*.mjs sync to the Editor. Get PROJECT_ID/BRANCH_ID from the Editor console: copy({PLAYCANVAS_BRANCH_ID: config.self.branch.id, PLAYCANVAS_PROJECT_ID: config.project.id}). Get the API key from playcanvas.com/<user>/account.
